messages:
Ana (PMM): Hey team — request prep for next week's webinar + benchmark release. Need a compact "asset bundle" we can hand to growth and sales. High level: 1) 16:9 slide deck template (master + 6 content slides) 2) 3 benchmark charts (latency vs cost sparkline, throughput bar, quality/regression callout) 3) Social pack (square, story, linkedin banner) 4) Email hero (600x200) and export for marketing system 5) One-pager PDF summary for sales + a PNG thumbnail for registrants. Goal: cohesive visual narrative for "inference economics" but lean and brand-safe.
Sara (Designer): OK — thanks. Can you confirm the visual tone? more chart-forward (data-first) or hero-image-forward (people + product)? Also: any required legal/partner logos to include? :thinking:
Ana (PMM): Data-first please, with a small hero panel on the first slide. No partner logos for this release. Use product wordmark set (dark/white variants). Tagline to use on slides: "Make inference predictable and economical."
Mike (Creative Ops): Timeline check — webinar is Thu 03/26, flighting starts Tue AM. Can we get an MVP pack by Mon EOD and final assets Wed noon? Otherwise growth can't queue promos. :eyes:
Liam (Growth): Confirming webinar date + registration URL: https://redwood.ai/events/launch-live (we'll swap if needed). Need a 1:1 thumbnail for the event page, plus a short looping GIF for Twitter/X and LinkedIn. GIF should be 4-6s max.
Sara (Designer): Got it. For the charts: do you have source CSVs or a mock dataset? I can craft stylized sparklines and bars but need numbers for labels.
Ana (PMM): Uploading sample CSV below — it's simplified. Please surface median latency, p50, p95, and cost per 1k tokens. Use callouts for the regression test that failed in canary (highlight with a red dot).
Ana (PMM): ```
model,workload,p50_ms,p95_ms,cost_per_1k
redwood-small,chat,45,120,0.12
redwood-medium,chat,30,85,0.18
open-large,chat,90,260,0.08
redwood-quantized,chat,35,95,0.06
``` 
Mike (Creative Ops): For output formats: supply editable Figma file, PNG/JPEG exports at required sizes, animated GIF + mp4 for social. We follow naming: rw_launch_YYYYMMDD_assetname_variant (e.g., rw_launch_20240326_deck_v1). Is that ok?
Sara (Designer): Works for me. Also need the brand compliance checklist (contrast, spacing, logo clearance). BrandBot — can you paste the latest checklist?
BrandBot: Brand compliance snapshot: • Primary palette: Redwood Red (#D3423F), Deep Navy (#0B1530), Soft Gray (#F5F7F9). • Logo safe zone = 16px on 72dpi output. • Type: Inter variable; weights: 400,600,700. • Chart rules: no more than 4 colors, avoid rainbow palettes, axis labels at 12px min. • Accessibility: contrast ratio min 4.5:1 for body text.
Ana (PMM): Great — Sara, keep charts two-color (accent + neutral). Use red accent for regression callout. For the one-pager, include 3 bullets: "cost per token", "latency SLOs", "deployment modes" — short sentences.
Sara (Designer): I'll mock the deck cover + 3 chart slides + social templates. MVP will be static PNGs + Figma link. Motion/GIF will be optional in MVP.
Mike (Creative Ops): I'll handle exports and the animated GIF after Sara hands motion frames. Please add a short 1-2 line caption for socials (Liam will help word): "Join our lightning webinar on running LLMs at predictable cost + latency. Wed 3/26 — sign up: <link>". Keep CTA = Register.
Liam (Growth): I'll draft captions and A/B test titles. Please deliver images by Mon EOD to the shared drive: https://drive.redwood.ai/marketing/launch_assets/2024Q2
Ana (PMM): Final approvals: Ana + Product + Brand. Sara — aim for MVP by Mon 8pm PT, final by Wed 12pm PT. If anything blocks, ping me or escalate to Mike. Thanks!
Sara (Designer): On it. Will post Figma link in this thread when MVP ready. :thumbsup:
Mike (Creative Ops): Noted — I'll create the delivery checklist and Asana task after Figma link. Tag me for motion.
Liam (Growth): :sparkles: excited. Let's make this clean and scannable for sales.
BrandBot: Reminder — file exports must include color swatches and a short notes doc with usage rules.
Ana (PMM): Perfect. Closing loop — deliver to the drive and drop links here. Thanks team.
